WITH existing AS (
  SELECT id AS customer_id, full_name, email, phone, false AS is_new
  FROM bookings.customers
  WHERE ((lower(email) = lower(NULLIF($2,'')) AND NULLIF($2,'') IS NOT NULL) OR phone = NULLIF($3,''))
  AND tenant_id = $4
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE bookings.customers
  SET full_name = CASE
    WHEN lower(email) = lower(NULLIF($2,'')) AND NULLIF($2,'') IS NOT NULL THEN $1
    ELSE full_name
  END,
      email = CASE
    WHEN NULLIF($2,'') IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF($2,'')
    ELSE email
  END,
      phone = COALESCE(NULLIF($3,''), phone)
  WHERE id = (SELECT customer_id FROM existing) AND tenant_id = $4
  RETURNING id AS customer_id, full_name, email, phone, false AS is_new
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO bookings.customers (tenant_id, full_name, email, phone)
  SELECT $4, $1, NULLIF($2,''), NULLIF($3,'')
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
    AND NULLIF($2,'') IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id AS customer_id, full_name, email, phone, true AS is_new
)
SELECT * FROM updated
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM inserted
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE bookings.customers
SET customer_type = 'contract'
WHERE id = $1::uuid

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO bookings.confirmed_bookings
  (tenant_id, customer_id, room_id, booking_date, date_from, date_to,
   start_time, end_time, total_amount, deposit_paid, balance_due,
   status, is_recurring, recurring_rule_id, recurring_series_id, series_label, updated_at)
SELECT
  $1, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, d::date, d::date, d::date,
  $5::time, $6::time,
  COALESCE(NULLIF($7,'')::numeric, 0),
  0,
  0,
  'confirmed', TRUE,
  NULLIF($8,'')::uuid,
  NULLIF($9,'')::uuid,
  $10, NOW()
FROM unnest(string_to_array($4, ',')) AS t(d)
WHERE $4 <> ''
  -- Guard 1: no overlapping confirmed booking (strict interval overlap)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bookings.confirmed_bookings ex
    WHERE ex.room_id    = $3::uuid
      AND ex.tenant_id  = $1::integer
      AND ex.status NOT IN ('cancelled')
      AND ex.booking_date = d::date
      AND ex.start_time  < $6::time
      AND ex.end_time    > $5::time
  )
  -- Guard 2: no conflicting active recurring rule at insert time
  -- Excludes our own just-created rule ($8) so it does not self-block
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bookings.recurring_rules rr
    WHERE rr.room_id    = $3::uuid
      AND rr.tenant_id  = $1::integer
      AND rr.active     = TRUE
      AND rr.id        != NULLIF($8,'')::uuid
      AND rr.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM d::date)::int
      AND rr.start_time  < $6::time
      AND rr.end_time    > $5::time
      AND (rr.end_date IS NULL OR rr.end_date >= d::date)
  )
RETURNING booking_date::text, id;

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(
  ARRAY_AGG(d::text ORDER BY d),
  ARRAY[]::text[]
) AS clashed_dates
FROM unnest(string_to_array($1, ',')) AS d
WHERE $1 <> ''
  AND (
    -- Check 1: Existing confirmed bookings (strict interval overlap)
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bookings.confirmed_bookings cb
      WHERE cb.room_id    = NULLIF($2,'')::uuid
        AND cb.tenant_id  = $3::integer
        AND cb.status NOT IN ('cancelled')
        AND d::date BETWEEN COALESCE(cb.date_from::date, cb.booking_date)
                        AND COALESCE(cb.date_to::date, cb.booking_date)
        AND cb.start_time < $5::time
        AND cb.end_time   > $4::time
    )
    -- Check 2: Active recurring rules — catches ungenerated future sessions
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bookings.recurring_rules rr
      WHERE rr.room_id    = NULLIF($2,'')::uuid
        AND rr.tenant_id  = $3::integer
        AND rr.active     = TRUE
        AND rr.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM d::date)::int
        AND rr.start_time < $5::time
        AND rr.end_time   > $4::time
        AND (rr.end_date IS NULL OR rr.end_date >= d::date)
    )
    -- Check 3: Manually blocked dates
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bookings.blocked_dates bd
      WHERE bd.tenant_id = $3::integer
        AND (
          (bd.block_type = 'oneoff' AND bd.block_date::date = d::date)
          OR (bd.block_type IN ('recurring', 'recurring-weekday') AND bd.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM d::date)::int)
          OR (bd.block_type = 'range' AND d::date BETWEEN bd.date_from::date AND bd.date_to::date)
        )
    )
  )

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(
  ARRAY_AGG(d::text ORDER BY d),
  ARRAY[]::text[]
) AS clashed_dates
FROM unnest(string_to_array($1, ',')) AS d
WHERE $1 <> ''
  AND (
    -- Check 1: Existing confirmed bookings (strict interval overlap)
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bookings.confirmed_bookings cb
      WHERE cb.room_id    = NULLIF($2,'')::uuid
        AND cb.tenant_id  = $3::integer
        AND cb.status NOT IN ('cancelled')
        AND d::date BETWEEN COALESCE(cb.date_from::date, cb.booking_date)
                        AND COALESCE(cb.date_to::date, cb.booking_date)
        AND cb.start_time < $5::time
        AND cb.end_time   > $4::time
    )
    -- Check 2: Active recurring rules — catches ungenerated future sessions
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bookings.recurring_rules rr
      WHERE rr.room_id    = NULLIF($2,'')::uuid
        AND rr.tenant_id  = $3::integer
        AND rr.active     = TRUE
        AND rr.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM d::date)::int
        AND rr.start_time < $5::time
        AND rr.end_time   > $4::time
        AND (rr.end_date IS NULL OR rr.end_date >= d::date)
    )
    -- Check 3: Manually blocked dates
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bookings.blocked_dates bd
      WHERE bd.tenant_id = $3::integer
        AND (
          (bd.block_type = 'oneoff' AND bd.block_date::date = d::date)
          OR (bd.block_type IN ('recurring', 'recurring-weekday') AND bd.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM d::date)::int)
          OR (bd.block_type = 'range' AND d::date BETWEEN bd.date_from::date AND bd.date_to::date)
        )
    )
  )
